results_grid_sprint_race_only_check.name: results_grid_sprint_race_only_check
results_grid_sprint_race_only_check.value: "results"."session_kind" in ('sprint', 'race') or ("results"."grid" is null and "results"."pit_lane_start" = false)

results_q_times_qualifying_only_check.name: results_q_times_qualifying_only_check
results_q_times_qualifying_only_check.value: "results"."session_kind" in ('qualifying', 'sprint_qualifying') or ("results"."q1_ms" is null and "results"."q2_ms" is null and "results"."q3_ms" is null)

pool_assets_one_subject_check.name: pool_assets_one_subject_check
pool_assets_one_subject_check.value:
("pool_assets"."asset_type" = 'driver' and "pool_assets"."driver_id" is not null and "pool_assets"."constructor_id" is null)
        or ("pool_assets"."asset_type" = 'constructor' and "pool_assets"."constructor_id" is not null and "pool_assets"."driver_id" is null)
